newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - American List rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - American List rating cut.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw Inc Tuesday downgraded its rating of American List Corp to neutral, citing the effects of changing market trends on the company's third-quarter results.

-- Rodman said third-quarter revenues fell four percent in the period to $4.6 million from $4.8 million because of a softening in credit card solicitations. Credit card companies make up about 20 percent of American List's revenue base.
-- Rodman also lowered its estimates for American List's fiscal 1996 earnings to $1.68 per share from $1.97, and the estimate for fiscal 1998 to $1.93 per share from $2.35.
-- American List compiles and sells computerized lists of college, high school and elementary students.
-- Its stock was down 7-5/8 Tuesday at 22-1/2.
